svg.title: State preparation and physical relaxation
svg.desc: Two perspectives on dissipative quantum dynamics. State preparation: design dissipative channels to steer different initial states toward a chosen stationary target state rho star. Physical relaxation: understand the decay modes and timescales of a given open system. The decay curves are schematic, not numerical results from a particular model.

g.aria-label: Lindblad generator applied to rho star equals zero
mode amplitude a n of t
a n of t is proportional to exp minus gamma n times t
